channel.title: Opera Solutions newsroom

item.title: Overture adds Pulse, leadership checks and PDF reports
item.description: Target lists kept under watch on their own timetable, a clear answer on who runs each company, and reports and call sheets that print.

item.title: Nabor is live on the App Store
item.description: Nabor, the London safety and disruption app we designed and built, is now available on iPhone across the United Kingdom.

item.title: LiveryLoop is live on the App Store
item.description: The app that brings yard managers, staff and horse owners together on one livery yard is now available on iPhone.

item.title: Introducing Opera Overture
item.description: An outbound sales system that finds, researches and contacts the right companies, and runs on a Mac mini in your own office.

item.title: Website packages and project deposits can now be paid online
item.description: Card payment for website packages, Mac mini deployment deposits and agreed invoices, straight from our website.

item.title: Clearby: a waste collection booked the way you book a ride
item.description: For Surrey Waste we built a customer app, a driver mode and a business portal that share one live view of every collection.

item.title: A new look for Opera Solutions
item.description: A new mark, a forest and mint palette, and a website rebuilt around the products we make.

item.title: callby.app goes live
item.description: The website for CALLBY, the chauffeur for your own car, with the app running live inside it.
